parameters.query:
use maestro;

SELECT
    i.id,
    i.idcliente,
    trim(concat(c.nombre," ",c.apellidop," ",c.apellidop)) as nombrecliente,
    i.id as idcontacto,
    i.nombrecliente as nombreusuario,
    i.correoContacto,
    i.noidentificacion,
    i.fecha_alta,
    v.isFrontValid,
    v.isBackValid,
    v.isNominalListValid
FROM identificaciones i
INNER JOIN verificamexvalidaciones v
    ON i.idverificamexvalidacion = v.id
inner join clientes c
    on c.id=i.idcliente
WHERE i.idrol = 4
AND (
     v.isFrontValid = 0
     OR v.isBackValid = 0
     OR v.isNominalListValid = 0
);
